title: Handshaker-rebuilt
description: A fork of the hand-shaker mod but with extra security steps for the Osmium server.
body: This is a fork of [Hand-shaker](https://modrinth.com/plugin/hand-shaker) meant to give more infomation then just the modlist. This is specificly built for [Osmium](https://github.com/djatlasv/Osmium). It'll share a hashed mac address to the server to have alt-banning more effective then the wifi itself. The server never sees the actuall mac-adress.
